'''Magnetic boots''' or '''magnetic traction boots'''<ref name="Elrood">[[Operation: Elrood (book)|''Operation: Elrood'']]</ref> were climbing equipment. [[Sura]] rented such equipment for 15 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] at [[Conical Six]] on the [[Centerpoint Station]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
